spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  metric_name,
  toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${metrics_interval_s} SECOND) AS time,
  (max(value) - min(value)) / ${metrics_interval_s} as value
FROM
  ${database}.${perf_table}
WHERE
  run_id = '${run_id}'
  AND metric_name IN ('disk_bytes_uncompressed_total', 'disk_bytes_compressed_total')
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY metric_name, time
ORDER BY time ASC

SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${metrics_interval_s} SECOND) as time,
  (max(value) - min(value)) / ${metrics_interval_s} as value
FROM ${database}.${perf_table}
WHERE
  run_id = '${run_id}'
  AND metric_name = 'disk_bytes_compressed_total'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time

SELECT
  attributes['query_name'] as query_name,
  quantile(0.5)(value) as value,
  toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${metrics_interval_s} SECOND) as timestamp
FROM
  ${database}.${perf_table}
WHERE
  run_id = '${run_id}'
  AND metric_name = 'query_latency_micros'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY query_name, timestamp
ORDER BY timestamp ASC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT
  concat(attributes['query_index'], ': ', attributes['query_name']) as query_name,
  any(toUInt64OrZero(attributes['perf.p90'])) as "target p90",
  quantile(0.90)(value) as p90,
  any(toUInt64OrZero(attributes['perf.p50'])) as "target p50",
  quantile(0.5)(value) as p50
FROM
  ${database}.${perf_table}
WHERE
  run_id = '${run_id}'
  AND metric_name = 'query_latency_micros'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY query_name
ORDER BY any(toUInt64OrZero(attributes['query_index'])) ASC

spec.description: Shows the latency per query, with target percentiles also present in the chart. Starts with the target p90 and actual p90, then target p50 and actual p50.
spec.title: Latency By Query (target/actual p90, target/actual p50)
